notes.title: v1.22 Update Announcement
notes.content:
1. Fixed the problem that dialog box clicks will get stuck.
2. Optimize the sorting of fish tank lists.
3. Fixed the problem that some achievements cannot be triggered.
4. Increase the offline income limit.

notes.title: v1.21 Update Announcement
notes.content:
1. The sorting function of fish tank details has been upgraded. After all functions are sorted, the same fish will be distributed together.
2. The new interface novice guide includes basic settings and game tutorials. Players can open it again in Settings->More->Tutorial.
3. The boss lady added a "starry eyes" animation.
4. A new function has been added to the fish ticket purchase interface. Click the pre-order number button to "one-click maximum" function.
5. Optimize the boss lady investment house.

notes.title: v1.2 Update Announcement
notes.content:
1. Updated new gameplay: Boss Lady's Investment House. Enter the store and click on the Boss Lady. Players can invest gold coins and the Boss Lady will give you rewards! ~
2. Added 32 new colorful fish. Try clicking on the new fish!
PS: The new fish added in this update can only be obtained in the Boss Lady's Investment House and will not be counted in the full picture book achievement

notes.title: v1.11 Update Announcement
notes.content:
1. Add the function of switching between regular fonts. Settings ->Language&Fonts ->Turn off Pixel Fonts, note that there may be lag when turned on for the first time. 
2.The fish ticket quantity button has been accelerated and optimized. 
3. The background music player has added a loop playback button, which allows users to choose between single loop and loop playback as needed.
4. Add fish detail data to the image guide interface.

notes.title: Announcement on Enabling Cloud Archive Function
notes.content:
1.If there are archives on multiple computers, please be cautious when opening cloud archives to prevent loss. 
2. You should enable cloud archiving on the Steam client of the computer you wish to upload to the cloud. 
3.If there is a save on another computer and you do not want it to be overwritten, please turn off the cloud save before starting the game to prevent data from being overwritten.

notes.title: v1.1 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[b]1. Update the store animation, the boss lady can now move! [/b]
2. Optimize the loading logic of the game. 
3. Resolve some bugs. 
[b]4. The achievement system is online, and there may be a delay in obtaining multiple achievements for the first time.[/b]

notes.title: v1.04 Update Announcement
notes.content:
1. Optimized the real-time bonus effect of the game. 
2. Fixed the situation where some fish did not reach their experience points when they grew up. 
3. Optimized the logic of fish experience growth.

notes.title: V1.03 Update Announcement
notes.content:
1. The bug where the price of the same type of normal fish would increase together with the rare fish when it was drawn has been fixed.
2. The bug where double the amount of money would be deducted when upgrading the fish tank in certain situations has been fixed.
3. An option to choose the language before entering the game has been added before starting the game and reopening the game.

notes.title: V1.02 Update Announcement
notes.content:
* Adjusted the growth and revenue values of some fish, reducing the cost of unlocking new fish tanks in the early game to help players get through the early stages faster.
* The one-click selling button has been changed to a hold-to-sell button with a footnote indicator to prevent players from accidentally selling fish.
